title: Hash functions, digital signatures and integrity

videos.script: Change one character of a message, and its fingerprint changes beyond recognition. That fingerprint is a hash, and it is everywhere in a network. {{hash}} In this lesson you will check a download against its list of digests, and then ask what that check actually proved. Against an accident, a lot. Against a person, very little. {{download}} Then a hash with a key, the way a payment provider proves a webhook is genuine. {{hmac}} Then a signature, which only one key can make and anybody can check. You will sign a release, and watch one appended byte break it. {{sign}} Last, the fingerprint SSH asks you to check, and why passwords need a hash that is deliberately slow. {{ssh}}
